Appearance:
 Shri Yogesh Singh Baghel - Advocate for petitioner.
 Shri V.S. Choudhary - Govt. Advocate for respondent

ORDER This petition is filed seeking the following reliefs :
(i) To issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents to award the petitioner compensation in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, in the interest of justice.
(ii) To issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the Sub- Divisional Officer, Tehsil Gadarwara, District Narsinghpur, Madhya Pradesh to decide the pending representation of the petitioner dated 12/08/2025 (Annexure-P/2), strictly in accordance with law,
in the interest of justice.
Any other relief may also be granted to the petitioner in such a case.

2. It is pointed out that a representation has been filed by the petitioner before the respondent-authority concerned in terms of Annexure P/2 which is pending consideration and has not been decided till date.

An innocuous prayer is made to direct the respondent No.2-Collector Shrikunj Kabra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92129826/
1

entities.text: Collector Shrikunj Kabra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Narsinghpur District Narsinghpur (M.P.) to consider and decide the pending representation expeditiously.
State counsel has no objection to the innocuous prayer made by the petitioner's counsel.

4. In such circumstances, this petition is disposed of by directing the petitioner to file a certified copy of this order to the respondent No.2 who, in turn, is directed to consider and decide the pending representation within a period of 90 days from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

5. Needless to mention that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.
6.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed of finally in above terms.
(VISHAL MISHRA) JUDGE VV Shrikunj Kabra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92129826/
